ui.hero.title: One platform for all the animals in Your care
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily work and teamwork in all Your locations. Find every action in Antz together with real screen views.
ui.modules.lede: Touch any card to open its guide together with all the functions and screen views.
ui.cta.text: In this guide are the functions and real screen views of every module. Continue from where you left off, or ask us and we will help.
ui.day.title: What Your first day in Antz is like
ui.day.4: Give everyone the right access rights
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that fit the organization and switch permissions on module by module, so that everyone sees what their job needs.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on a phone and a computer?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app covers fieldwork, for example notes, treatment, transfers and egg data. The web app covers desk work, for example the hospital system, nursery setup, reports and pharmacy stock. Changes appear in real time on the phone, tablet and desktop computer.
ui.faq.q3: Can we determine who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is role-based. You create the roles used in the organization, for example Zoologist, and switch permissions on module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We have several locations. Is that suitable?
ui.faq.a4: Antz keeps the data of all locations and departments in one place. Placement is organized by location, section and enclosure, and transfers between locations go through approval and check-out with a security check.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the guide “Getting Started” and then open the modules that Your role uses. If something remains unclear, write to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Dissection
m.necropsy.intro: The Dissection module documents post-mortem examinations together with detailed observations, organ-by-organ findings and medical conclusions. It supports accurate analysis of the cause of death, unifies reporting, ensures timely handling of carcasses and meets legal, audit and veterinary requirements.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filters
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by location, date and priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Track the stages: incoming, pending, draft and completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, reason, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Worm control
m.deworming.intro: The Worm control module supports the systematic recording and tracking of parasite-control treatment, ensuring timely administration, proper documentation and clear tracking of all worm-control actions of each animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Status-based views
m.deworming.f1.desc: Worm controls are divided for easy tracking: upcoming, pending, skipped and done.
m.deworming.f2.title: Worm control management
m.deworming.f2.desc: Plan a course of treatment or record the administered medicine directly together with dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Recording the administration
m.deworming.f3.desc: Saves the dose, batch number, method of administration, notes and optional follow-up check.
m.housing.title: Placement
m.housing.intro: The Placement module organizes the animals' habitats by Your locations, sections and enclosures, so that the location of every animal is known and every change is traceable. Access at every level is based on permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Location management
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or change locations with role-based permissions, to ensure secure and structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section management
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or change zoo sections with permission-based controls, so that management is secure.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure management
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or change enclosures and track each one, in order to review animals and data efficiently.
m.fetal-death.title: Death of the fetus
m.fetal-death.intro: The Death of the fetus module registers and manages cases of fetal death that occurred in enclosures, saving the cause, time and data of the animals concerned. It supports veterinary care, monitoring of reproductive health, analysis of trends and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Adding a fetal death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Enter new cases: cause, time, descent, animal data.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filters
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by location, date, stillbirth or abortion, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: Viewing death case records
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full data, days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, location, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Egg module tracks the whole life cycle of eggs from laying to hatching or transfer to the nursery, ensuring accurate data, real-time updates and full traceability, so that the cooperation and responsibility of the nest, nursery and incubation teams would be better.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Real-time numbers: in the nest, taken to the nursery, marked for destruction.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs together with parents, condition, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the full timeline of the egg's journey.
m.administer-medicine.title: Administering medicines
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Administration module complements the health records, turning prescriptions into applicable treatment workflows and enabling real-time treatment for individual animals or groups of animals both in the field and in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for the chosen date without compiling a full health record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filters
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find records quickly and narrow the list by date, object, species or controlled substance. [?]
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatment by date on four tabs: pending, administered, skipped, completed.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccination module manages the whole life cycle of animal vaccination from planning and direct administration to tracking upcoming, pending, skipped and done vaccinations. It ensures timely treatment, accurate recording of doses and full traceability for disease prevention and meeting clinical requirements.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Status-based views
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations are divided for easy tracking: upcoming, pending, skipped and done.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Plan a vaccination or record the administered vaccine directly together with dates and medicine data.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Recording the administration
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Saves the dose, batch number, method of administration, notes and optional follow-up check.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Makes it possible to dispense medical products quickly, accurately and traceably directly to authorized doctors, ensuring timely fulfilment and automatic updating of the stock level from prescription to shelf, as well as batch-level visibility and expiry tracking throughout the process.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time overview of stock problems, shipments, purchases, requests, use, expiring and fast-moving products together with visual trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filters
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Find records quickly by request ID, doctor's name or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master data (shelves and shelf spots)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by the number of shelves and shelf spots for quick access and updating, with customizable data (packaging, unit of measure, salts, active substances, manufacturers).
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Stock report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Batch-based stock level together with value and expiry; mark low-stock or expired products; track upcoming expiries; manage the deposit together with dispute resolution. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product and stock management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track stocks and expiry, record purchases and dispensing, keep a single general ledger, manage substitute products and variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Dispensing management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can prescribe and dispense medicines or receive them directly from the pharmacy, everything is logged.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing medicine shipments and complete them in the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock corrections and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record changes in stock level (missing, broken, expired); keep the audit history; manage returns to the supplier; download reports of consumption, returns, purchases and dispensing for finance and demand planning.
m.getting-started.title: Getting started
m.getting-started.intro: The Getting started guide introduces the purpose of the app and leads new users through the important steps: setting up a profile, getting to know the main functions and moving efficiently around the platform.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and open the work environment assigned to You.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home page feed for updates and quick links, and the bottom panel for the main tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Pending dissection / administration / placement
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals that are waiting for dissection, the compiling of administrative documents and then placement or destruction before the records are finally closed.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master data setup and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Set up the master data and get to know modules such as health records, placement, eggs, nutrition and animal management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your profile and change language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand which access levels are needed for secure work.
